# SkyTube 1.0.5 — exact cloud opacity and reliable loading controls

This patch follows another independent review of the full original request. It preserves the sky display, adjustable visibility, hotkeys/popup, playlists, live controls, chat/account features and all three provider choices. Three reproduced problems were corrected before release.

## Fixes

- **Exact cloud-slider endpoints:** a position labeled 0% could save about 0.34% opacity and still write cloud depth over the display; a position labeled 100% could save about 99.66%. Slider submissions now match the whole percentage displayed. Real Minecraft widget clicks verify exact 0 and 1. Directly configured fractional values remain supported.
- **Catch-up after a delayed rewind acknowledgment:** an earlier, still-pending rewind no longer looks like a new user scrub when it lands after Catch-up is re-enabled. A subsequent deliberate iframe rewind still suspends catch-up. The fix retains real-position checks so an ignored forward catch-up seek can be retried after the normal cooldown.
- **Immediate feedback for controls used during loading:** Rewind, Previous, Next and Go live now check whether the chosen source/provider is acknowledged and ready. An early action reports that it did not run and asks the player to retry when ready. A stale ready report from the previous source does not permit a silently dropped action. Rapid navigation and rewinds remain available once the current player is ready; play/pause intent and preferences still work during startup.

New failure cases were reproduced against the released code. The player correction also passed an independent clock simulation with delayed rewind acknowledgment at 125, 750 and 1,450 ms and a player that ignored forward catch-up seeks.

## Verification

[Required main CI](https://github.com/Eabusham2/SkyTube/actions/runs/45128060358) passed on the exact release source, `79a1d9c4912346bf171720836c7cb17e64a75bf7`: Ubuntu build, Windows build and actual native Minecraft/MCEF Chromium. The native run passed **24 playback checkpoints and 5 loading-control cases** and produced **21 verified PNG screenshots**. [Native test evidence](https://github.com/Eabusham2/SkyTube/actions/runs/45128060358/artifacts/14796492684). Both CI JARs match the independently built local archives byte for byte.

The final local production build passed **117 Java tests**, **43 Node tests** and **5 release-verifier test groups**, with no failed or skipped Java/Node cases. All three workflows passed actionlint. The integrated Minecraft texture fixture passed **24 playback checkpoints and 5 loading-control cases**, produced **21 readable screenshots**, and checked exact cloud-slider endpoints, exact 90% visibility, Account-draft resize and world-exit cleanup. The new loading checks included two real J keypresses and the Go live button after readiness, with no acknowledgment between actions. A separate local audit reached all eight key handlers; the N case verified the pre-load handler only.

Software OpenGL readbacks confirmed the cloud endpoint's color/depth effect and unchanged pixels outside the display. Six independent readable/locked synthetic credential-store cases passed across Linux, macOS and Windows storage protocols. An actual loopback check also verified current-video confirmation and world teardown.

The local rendering fixture uses a test texture; required GitHub CI uses actual MCEF/Chromium. Account, OAuth and credential-store checks use local fixtures and synthetic credentials. No real Google login, rating, comment or chat message was performed.

Publication requires the exact tagged commit to pass native Minecraft/Chromium testing, a Linux build/tests, JAR integrity and version checks, SHA-256 verification and an unchanged-tag check. Main CI also checks Windows. macOS compilation remains optional. This patch changes no workflow, dependency version or existing external-playback waiver.

# SkyTube 1.0.4 — exact visibility and ordered playback controls

This patch follows an independent review of the complete original request. All requested controls remain implemented, including normal YouTube, No-Cookie and the yout-ube destination. Four reproduced failures were fixed before release.

## Fixes

- **The 90% slider means 90%:** the visibility slider now saves the whole percentage shown by its label. A real minimum-size widget click followed by a world scene with exactly 90% sampled visibility verifies playback and unmuting. Directly configured fractional thresholds remain supported.
- **Restart live catch-up after a rewind:** enabling Catch-up starts fresh live observations, so an earlier position cannot immediately cancel the new request. A subsequent deliberate DVR rewind still suspends automatic catch-up.
- **Navigate immediately after turning shuffle off:** Next, Previous and provider changes use the intended original queue while the iframe still reports a stale shuffled order. The fix also handles a late shuffled report after an apparently restored queue, duplicate entries, naturally advancing playback and known trailing playlist additions. Account/chat targets remain unconfirmed until the reported queue, item and video agree.
- **Preserve startup and command ordering:** 600 preference updates before the browser's first poll no longer discard the selected video or provider. Preferences are coalesced only between transport actions, while real Live and Catch-up transitions remain ordered. Live on → Go live → off, Catch-up off → rewind → on, Catch-up off/on after an earlier rewind, and Shuffle on → Next → off retain their intended behavior.

New regression cases were reproduced against the released behavior before the fixes. Independent cross-review also replayed actual loopback HTTP responses through the production JavaScript using local iframe fixtures.

## Verification

[Required main CI](https://github.com/Eabusham2/SkyTube/actions/runs/45124322303) passed on the exact release source, `3c0ab21128c16ff5339d65e0bc93924eb5b9c2dd`: Ubuntu build, Windows build and actual native Minecraft/MCEF Chromium. The native run passed all **24 bridge checkpoints** and produced **21 verified PNG screenshots**, including the real 90% slider boundary. [Native test evidence](https://github.com/Eabusham2/SkyTube/actions/runs/45124322303/artifacts/14794539814). Both CI JARs match the independently built local archives byte for byte.

The combined local production build passed **117 Java tests**, **41 Node tests** and **5 release-verifier test groups**, with no failed or skipped Java/Node cases. All three workflows passed actionlint. The combined local Minecraft GPU texture fixture passed **24 bridge checkpoints**, produced **21 readable screenshots**, and retained Account-draft resize and world-exit cleanup assertions. The real slider-click boundary case passed. Independent software OpenGL checks exercised both production shader pairs at 0%, 50% and 100% cloud opacity and verified unchanged pixels outside the mask.

The local texture fixture uses a test texture; required GitHub CI uses actual MCEF/Chromium. Account, OAuth and credential-store checks use local fixtures and synthetic credentials. No real Google login, rating, comment or chat message was performed.

Release publication requires the exact tagged commit to pass native Minecraft/Chromium testing, a clean Linux build/tests, JAR integrity and version checks, SHA-256 verification and a final unchanged-tag check. Main CI also checks Windows. macOS compilation remains optional and is not a release dependency. This patch changes no workflow or existing external-playback waiver.
